scope: One pinned local four-domain research host; original browser SCXML runtime plus explicit adapters; native browser keyboard actions and separately labelled synthetic composition/control cases

cases.expected: Original schemas and exact browser-loaded source/dependency hashes verified for the common closure
A/B start closed, named and independent without dangling active descendant or unexpected public event
Browser ArrowDown opens A through real overlay/scroll children; input keeps focus and first enabled result becomes active
Navigation skips disabled entries, reaches last result without wrapping, and actually scrolls it into the 160px viewport
Actual browser AX tree exposes distinct combobox names, expanded relation, active option, polite atomic status and no added container tabstop
Browser Enter emits exactly one declared value-change payload, sets label/key, closes views, clears active relation, keeps input focus and leaves B unchanged
Opening and Escape on B produce no extra commit or A mutation; B children are cancelled
Programmatic known value updates label/key without user commit; unknown key rejected
Input creates loading/current request; reverse-order replies only accept newest generation and do not announce stale results
Empty and provider failure yield actual empty/error states, no active target, correct busy/status and retained committed value
Invalid T1/duplicate-key provider data is diagnosed before partial rendering and reaches controlled error state
Synthetic composition input suppresses Enter/navigation and interim provider requests; compositionend requests the final query
Browser Tab/focus loss closes without commit and removes stale relations; native text editing remains available
Held child initialization followed by close/reopen cannot revive old view or break new native route; B stays unchanged
Actual malformed child source becomes explicit error relay, closes affected children and exposes accessible status without altering B
A/B overlays follow their own input bottom with 8px gap after input geometry changes; variable rows still reveal active result
Late provider reply after close/reopen is rejected without state, public-event or status changes
Foreign native report is delivered but rejected by explicit instance/epoch guards, leaving actual view and selection unchanged
Actual browser AX snapshots reflect loading/error/closed changes without stale active option and distinguish observed AX text from untested speech
Final original sources unchanged, live/runtime/errors/cancel journals and browser environment captured; no unexpected unhandled errors
